annotations.text: Foundations. Severity = colour + icon + text (never colour alone). Palette carried forward from Security Auditor (warm neutral + terracotta) and shipped as swappable tokens. The Finding card is the one atom reused, degraded, in every target.

Desktop app = local browser window at 127.0.0.1, 1440x900 baseline, single window / no routing, no account or marketing surface. Static mockups (not a clickable prototype). EdgeStates stacks Zero / Partial / Error; split into three artboards if you want them separate.

One report design, two renderings. Left = self-contained HTML file (CLI + skill), on-screen view, JS-free, collapsible via <details>. Right = the same file's print stylesheet: grayscale-safe severity, all findings expanded, full link URLs, hard page breaks. Markdown report is a written spec, not an artboard.
